title: Survey similar medical imaging agent repositories
summary: Primary-source survey of 28 related projects. Closest comparisons: HealthAgentBench, ABRA, BCER, AutoMedBench, Imaging-101 and RadAgent. Assistant recommends explicit assistance conditions, independent physical output scoring, and separate process/execution evidence. MedOpenClaw, AMID and SpatialMed have observed release gaps. No adoption or trial decision.
